description: Billie generates configurable visual representations of building information models. Helga Tauscher at TU Dresden CIB provides a Java and Groovy mapping engine that combines BIM inputs with precompiled configurations or a visualization description. The own documentation lists IFC geometry, GAEB cost views and animated construction schedules, with sample building and airport projects. Spatial detail and time coverage follow the BIM and schedule supplied by the user. It can support inspection of construction simulation inputs and outputs and related building-model research. Source code is free under GPL-2.0, with command-line viewers and modular data and scene interfaces. A limitation is the prototype status: the Groovy description language supports only part of the precompiled functionality, and several documentation sections remain unfinished. Different BIM formats also require matching configurations. No sample model or archive was downloaded, and current Java compatibility was not tested.
